note: The OpusKit recipe this site was built from. Keep it: OpusKit reads it to open the site in the kit.

brief.name: Kür Delta Watch
brief.offer: A volunteer river watch on the lower Kür: we pull rubbish out of the river, test the water every month and publish what we find.

pages.label: Home
pages.purpose: Establish mood and promise in seconds; orient the visitor to what this site is and give them a clear next step.

pages.label: The river
pages.purpose: Put a human face and point of view on the work; build trust.

pages.label: What we do
pages.purpose: Make the offer and the way of working clear enough to remove hesitation.

pages.label: Field notes
pages.purpose: Let real clients or customers make the case, in their own words.

pages.label: Donate
pages.purpose: Turn a visitor into a donor: give once or monthly, preset amounts that each say what they pay for (a sack of rubbish out, a month of water tests, a boat day), how the money is spent, and a short donation form.

pages.label: Contact
pages.purpose: Give one clear, low-friction way to get in touch.
